backend/main.mo: Actor initializes access control state and mixes in authorization behavior.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing maintenance‑mode feature and related files/components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files for reference.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template including public base URL and maintenance‑mode flag.
frontend/DOMAIN_CHANGE.md: Checklist for updating the app’s domain configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component that toggles between maintenance screen and normal app based on config.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with title, description, and hero image.
Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and page structure.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer with copyright, branding, and dynamic UTM tracking link.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with branding and Internet Identity login/logout button logic.
frontend/src/components/MainContent.tsx: Main tabbed UI for profile, prediction, growth logging, and recommendations.
frontend/src/components/MaintenanceScree: Full‑page downtime screen displayed when maintenance mode is enabled.
frontend/src/components/NormalApp.tsx: Authenticated app shell rendering hero, content, and optional profile‑setup dialog.
frontend/src/config/maintenance.ts: Parses VITE_MAINTENANCE_MODE to a boolean used for maintenance‑mode logic.
frontend/src/features/growth/GrowthChart: Recharts line chart showing height measurements over time.
frontend/src/features/growth/GrowthLogPa: UI panel for viewing, adding, editing, and deleting height log entries with chart and table support.
frontend/src/features/prediction/compone: Displays a loading card with a spinning icon and text while prediction calculations are running.
frontend/src/features/prediction/predict: Implements multiple height prediction formulas and returns individual results plus an average of enabled methods.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Predict: Landing screen offering navigation between standard height prediction and puberty-stage estimator workflows.
Controls navigation between landing, standard prediction, and puberty-stage estimator views.
Displays detailed height prediction results, including averages and individual formula outputs.
frontend/src/features/prediction/puberty: Estimates bone age from puberty stage and predicts final height using bone age, growth rates, and parental height.
Defines puberty questionnaire data and computes a puberty stage result based on scored answers.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Puberty: Shows puberty-stage assessment results, estimated bone age, and height prediction with navigation options.
Handles the puberty questionnaire flow, tracking answers and showing results after completion.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Standar: Runs standard height prediction calculations, displays results, and saves predictions when authenticated.
frontend/src/features/profile/ProfileInp: Profile form component that loads user data, syncs growth logs, handles height input units, and saves profile updates.
frontend/src/features/profile/ProfileSet: Initial profile setup dialog collecting basic info and saving a minimal user profile.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/re: Defines age‑based diet and exercise recommendation lists and a function that returns them based on age and gender.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/Re: Shows diet and exercise recommendations based on user profile with disclaimers and age-specific notices.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity login, storage, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles and growth logs through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeActor.ts: Actor hook that initializes access control with error handling and refreshes dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining a neon‑green dark theme with CSS variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that sets up QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/types/app-types.ts: Defines TypeScript types for user profiles, height logs, and prediction results used throughout the app.
frontend/src/utils/age.ts: Utility functions for calculating age from a birthdate or numeric years.
frontend/src/utils/heightInput.ts: Utilities for sanitizing, formatting, and parsing height inputs depending on unit type.
frontend/src/utils/units.ts: Conversion helpers between centimeters, inches, and formatted feet‑inches strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), store and retrieve them from sessionStorage, and synchronize URL values with session persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, animations, and plugin setup for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON file describing the project’s current state, including metadata, versions, existing features, and no new feature requests.
